name: My New Topic
practice_prompt: The student proposes; you question and constrain. Follow the stage order. One question per turn.

practice_stages.label: end in mind
practice_stages.focus: Clarify what we're building. Ask the student what the end result should show.

practice_stages.label: step two
practice_stages.focus: First concrete step — ask the student to name or draft it.

practice_stages.label: step three
practice_stages.focus: Next piece — one guiding question only.

practice_stages.label: wrap up practice
practice_stages.focus: Final piece of the exercise before lesson complete.

final_example: A short model answer shown only at wrap-up if the student asks.
